metrics.views: Existing 11 HumanML263 views; no new behavioral threshold
metrics.temporal_energy: Mean squared temporally centered normalized features
metrics.identity: E(f11) = four component energies + six twice-covariances

aggregation: Equal source means, min/max/planned/valid n; retain split/config/condition/t/arm separately. No pooling diffusion times or treating frames as independent sources.
interpretation: Different F/U x_t and different times are descriptive only. GT is fixed-time reference, not a conditional expectation. Variance is not behavior correctness. All negative cases and incomplete denominators retained; not blind or independent review.
